summary: Most requested pages, routing, branding theme, and the demo chat flow with React Query hooks were added. Key gaps are around backend message attribution for bot vs user and user-visible error handling for send-message failures. There are also some extra footer/social/attribution additions not requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: Chat page supports a ChatGPT-like UI with bot response flow (user + bot messages)
missing_requirements.reason: The frontend generates a bot reply but persists it by calling the same `sendMessage` backend method that records `sender : Principal` as the caller. There is no evidence of a backend field/flag to mark messages as bot vs user, so the conversation cannot reliably render distinct user/bot roles in a ChatGPT-like timeline.

missing_requirements.requirement: React Query mutations show visible error UI states (no silent failures)
missing_requirements.reason: Chat history query includes loading/error UI, but send-message failures are only logged to console in the chat send handler; there is no evidence of an on-screen error message/toast for message send or bot-reply send failures.

hallucinated_features.description: Footer social links and an additional attribution ('Caffeine.ai attribution')
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not ask for social media icons/links or any attribution other than 'Developed by Kairav'.
A light/dark theme provider was added but not explicitly requested in the BuildRequest requirements.
